subtitle: Optimize your Relewise setup
description: Connect to your authorized Relewise Datasets to inspect entities, analyze search and revenue performance, review API consumption, audit configuration, and manage supported merchandising, Search Tools, and Retail Media settings.
starterPrompts: Review search performance for my Relewise Dataset.
Audit merchandising rules for my Relewise Dataset.

testCases.userPrompt: Help me connect Relewise, then show my accessible Datasets.
testCases.expectedOutput: OAuth consent completes and only Datasets permitted for the reviewer are listed.

testCases.userPrompt: Review search performance for Dataset <review-dataset> for the last 30 days.
testCases.expectedOutput: Search KPIs and prioritized findings for the requested Dataset and date range.

testCases.userPrompt: Find the Product named <sample-product> and show its stored properties.
testCases.expectedOutput: The matching Product and its stored properties are returned without guessing an ID.

testCases.userPrompt: Audit the merchandising rules for Dataset <review-dataset> and identify conflicts or gaps.
testCases.expectedOutput: An evidence-based audit of existing rules without changing them.

testCases.userPrompt: Show Search and Recommendations consumption for Dataset <review-dataset> for the last 30 days.
testCases.expectedOutput: Consumption summaries labeled with the requested period and Dataset.

negativeTestCases.expectedBehavior: Deny the request without retrying through another transport or claiming access.
Explain that Agent Gateway policy does not allow the requested connection or area.

negativeTestCases.userPrompt: Show me how to implement a Relewise product search request in C#.
negativeTestCases.expectedBehavior: Do not invoke this business-facing plugin; route the task to Relewise Developer.

demoRecording.reusePolicy: Reuse only when it still demonstrates every submitted workflow and the portal accepts it.
